detail: Container isolation, 100% clean stability, no known confound.
Cheapest generation, largest suite, 100% clean stability.

Agent abandoned the SPA UI and tested the REST API instead. 0/25 faults could arm because WebTestPilot injects into the DOM. Clean-stability and cost figures are valid; activation and detection are not measuring UI oracle strength.

4 of 90 tests fail deterministically on the clean app (back-office Discounts/Cart-Rules/Stats). Excluded from every verdict by the classifier, so they cannot manufacture a catch, but they contribute no detection capability.

Packaged system prompt told the agent to author tests itself while the driver prompt told it to delegate. 30/36 specs carry generator provenance, so 6 were authored outside the generator. Fixed afterwards in generate.py; re-run staged at /tmp/scale/rerun_bs_B_fixed.sh.
9/9 specs carry generator provenance. Transcript records no role-named delegation, but its task_started records carry no subagent_type field at all, so absence is not evidence of absence.
Planner produced plans but the generator subagent never ran; 0/9 specs stamped and 0 generator delegations recorded. Not evaluated. Recorded as playwright-agents-HYBRID-INVALID.

Generation stopped on the --max-budget-usd 12 cap at total_cost_usd 12.05, so the healer ran ~2 rounds versus 18 on bookstack. 52 of 99 tests fail deterministically on the clean app (broken locators, selectOption API misuse, strict-mode violations), leaving 47 usable - 47.5%, worst in the campaign. Evaluation also aborted once at bug 5/23 on a separate harness bug (READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS never exported to start_app.sh); fixed and re-run to completion. Activation 6/23 = 26.1% is VALID (activation depends on navigation, not assertions). Clean-stability and detection figures do NOT represent the architecture. Fair re-run ~25-30 USD.
